tooling.name: lightningcss
tooling.reason: CSS transformer used by Vite and Tailwind while building. It runs on the build machine and no part of it is in the output.

tooling.name: lru-cache
tooling.reason: Cache used inside build and test tools (jsdom, the message compiler). Not in the output.

tooling.name: minimatch
tooling.reason: Glob matcher used by ESLint and other tools. Not in the output.

tooling.name: tslib
tooling.reason: Runtime helpers of the WebAssembly loaders inside Storybook and the message compiler. Not in the output.

tooling.name: argparse
tooling.reason: Command-line parser of the WOFF2 encoder that the font tool uses. It runs on the build machine and is not in the output.

notShipped.name: elkjs
notShipped.reason: The ELK layout engine, installed as a dependency of mermaid. The build puts a stub in its place (the alias in vite.config.ts, src/lib/editor/no-elk.ts) and diagrams are laid out with dagre. Should it ever be bundled, the notices step, which has no exceptions, fails the build.

notShipped.name: robust-predicates
notShipped.reason: Arrives with d3 (through d3-delaunay), which mermaid depends on. Nothing the diagrams use imports it, so it is not in the output; the notices step fails the build if that changes.

stated.name: khroma
stated.reason: Colour functions used by mermaid. Its package.json has no licence field; the licence file in the package is the MIT licence.

vendored.name: shadcn-svelte
vendored.reason: Its CLI writes the components under src/lib/ui, which are compiled into the output.

vendored.name: @inlang/paraglide-js
vendored.reason: Its compiler writes the message runtime under src/lib/i18n/paraglide, which is compiled into the output.

unlabelled.name: svelte-toolbelt
unlabelled.reason: Its package.json has no license member. The LICENSE file it ships is the MIT text; the build reads that file and stops if its first line is no longer this one.

derived.name: cldr-annotations-full
derived.reason: tools/emoji/build.ts writes the emoji lists under src/lib/editor/emoji from its names and keywords.

derived.name: cldr-annotations-derived-full
derived.reason: The same lists take the names of flags, keycaps and joined emoji from it.
